problem.title: Construct a Binary Search Tree from Search Access Frequencies
problem.problemStatement: Given a set of distinct keys and their search access frequencies, construct a Binary Search Tree that minimizes the weighted search cost.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the keys. • The third line contains the corresponding search frequencies.
problem.output: • Print the constructed Binary Search Tree.
